definitions.explanation: A flat receptacle used for carrying or displaying items. From English 'tray'. Widely used in restaurants, cafeterias, and fast food shops in Japan.

examples.japanese: トレー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧トレー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{載|の}せた→載せる：28290_noseru⟧。
examples.english: I put food on a tray at the cafeteria.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、トレー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{返却口|へんきゃくぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}して→戻す：02317_modosu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When you're done eating, please return your tray to the return counter.

notes:
A loanword from English 'tray'. Commonly encountered in fast food restaurants, cafeterias, and food courts where customers carry their own food on trays.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- トレー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧: to place on a tray
- トレー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧: to return a tray
- トレー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to clear away a tray
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧トレー: food tray (the styrofoam trays used for supermarket meat and fish)

USAGE:
In Japanese supermarkets, ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧トレー refers to the disposable styrofoam trays used to package meat, fish, and other fresh foods. Many supermarkets have collection bins for recycling these trays.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盆|ぼん}→盆：03897_bon⟧: tray — the traditional Japanese word for a tray, typically a round lacquered serving tray
- ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧: plate, dish — flat tableware for serving food directly
